- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:1435-1439 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: When a push invocation has a warning about unresolved Git directory, the guard clears both the warning and arguments, then checks the session checkout's PR history instead of asking for confirmation.
  WHY: A push with `GIT_DIR+=other git push origin HEAD:feature/x` queries the checkout's PR history rather than asking about the unresolved target; a merged PR on the checkout branch could trigger a false merge-guard block.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:569-577 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: When both `--repo` and a positional repository are supplied, a positional URL is looked up as a remote name and the guard asks for confirmation instead of checking the merged PR.
  WHY: `git push --repo=https://github.com/other/repo https://github.com/o/r.git HEAD:feature/x` asks for confirmation instead of blocking on the merged branch.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:1443-1445 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: A commit with an unresolved directory requests confirmation instead of checking the session checkout.
  WHY: A commit invoked after a conditional `cd` that did not execute asks for confirmation instead of warning and allowing.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:494 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The warning message for unresolved git command directory was shortened, but the corresponding test assertions still expect the full message.
  WHY: `test_appended_git_override_falls_back_without_using_rhs` fails for both `GIT_DIR` and `GIT_WORK_TREE` parametrizations with an assertion error on the warning text.
- tests/test_pr_merge_status_guard.py:1040-1041 | severity=NIT | confidence=1
  PROBLEM: The two new parametrized test cases for `--repo upstream` and `--rep upstream` are correct and expose no issue.
  WHY: With no positional repository or refspec, the guard correctly identifies the unverified destination and asks for confirmation.

  Expected change site: tests/test_codex_agent_isolation_contract.py::test_no_codex_agent_is_started_outside_the_isolation_helpers at line 61
  Evidence of absence: The test uses `SCRIPTS.glob("*.sh") + SCRIPTS.glob("*.py") + WORKFLOWS.glob("*.yml")` (line 61), all non-recursive. It scans only top-level files under scripts/ and .github/workflows/ but never descends into .github/actions/ (which contains action.yml files that can launch codex) or any nested subdirectory under scripts/. A direct codex launch in those locations would not be caught by this test, contradicting the docstring's claim that the test pins "every Codex agent that reads untrusted text runs isolated". This is a pre-existing gap; the LAST RUN did not touch this file.
